intervals: [0,0.1], (0.1,0.2], ..., (0.9,1.0]; right-closed, with zero included in the first bin
boundary_implementation: np.digitize(confidence, np.linspace(0,1,nbins+1), right=True), clipped to valid zero-based bin indices
confidence: maximum normalized probability across all fine classes
correctness: argmax of the same probability row equals the true fine label
weighting: each nonempty bin's absolute accuracy-confidence gap is weighted by that bin's row share
rare_row_ece: same top-label calculation restricted to rows whose true fine label is in the fixed rare-class set; not rare-class-only probability normalization
frozen_probability_treatment: all frozen float16 matrices are converted to float64 and renormalized consistently before metric computation
aggregation: six seed-specific ECE values, arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1)

endpoint_scope.calibration: all ten available methods, all six seeds; includes all nine Table 4 arms and all three fitted gate variants
endpoint_scope.lofo: classification and novelty endpoints do not currently report ECE; any derivative ECE calculation must use this explicit 10-bin protocol on saved probabilities
endpoint_scope.scarcity: classification endpoints do not currently report ECE; any derivative ECE calculation must use this explicit 10-bin protocol on saved probabilities
endpoint_scope.capture_windows: classification endpoint does not currently report ECE; any derivative ECE calculation must use this explicit 10-bin protocol. Reused legacy taxonomy controls retain hard labels only, so their ECE cannot be recovered from those checkpoints

calibrator_fit_role: utility/calibration only; selection was reported only in the primary frozen comparisons
